PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Players choose which ores their ship drills void as they mine
PluginData.Description:
OreYeeter lets every player keep their own list of ores that their ship drills void while mining, so unwanted stone and ice never fill the containers. The ore is never created, which also saves server work.
A drill voids ore when its name contains the tag (default !ore), or for all of a player's drills after !ore auto. Commands: !ore list, !ore add, !ore remove, !ore auto, !ore clean (removes listed ores already stored on a grid). Admins can set a server wide ore list that players cannot remove (!ore master ...), or in the Quasar config.
Also available as a Torch plugin, both builds share the same code.
